basic_info.description: Flooded wtih natural light, this two-level penthouse truly delivers with classic architecture, soaring volumes, fabulous floor plan & views.  Occupies top two floors of a 3-unit condo bldg on a prime flat block of Pacific Heights.  WalkScore of 98, block f/ Union Street's upscale shopping+dining district. Ideal for entertaining, the great room w/ WB fireplace opens to north-facing stone terrace w/ partial views of Bay & GG Bridge. Skylit dining area, gourmet gas kitchen. Rich, warmly neutral color scheme w/ walnut-stained floors throughout. Generously proportioned rooms.  Fabulous master suite w/ large terrace views of Bay, GGB, Rus Hill.  Two more BR & BAs, so. terrace, W/D, one car pkg. Pet friendly.
